name: warming up in lunge (three)
description: Lunge warm-up, part 3: add an upper-body reach and gentle rotation to a low kneeling lunge.
instructions: Step into a low lunge with the rear knee padded and the front foot planted.
Rest one hand lightly on the front thigh for balance.
Turn your chest gently toward the front-leg side as the other arm reaches diagonally upward.
Return to center, then switch sides and repeat within a comfortable range.
